nameEn: Retail sale of clothing in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of clothing in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of articles of clothing: coats, jackets, trousers, dresses, skirts
retail sale of clothing accessories: scarves, ties, gloves, belts
excludes: retail sale of footwear and leather goods, see 4772
retail sale of sports clothing (in sports stores), see 4763
